item.text: I’ll translate the requested η kinematics into EXCLURAD’s required input layout, validate every point with the registered solver, then write the chunked input file(s) and outcome manifest.
All 25 endpoint-inclusive points pass the η threshold, beam-accessibility, table-coverage, and cut checks. I’m using a uniform 14.375° spacing so that the stated count and both endpoints are honored.

item.text:
Generated and validated all 25 η points; EXCLURAD chunked them into 10/10/5-point inputs.

[Outcome manifest](outcome.json) records the 6.53 GeV default-beam warning and the endpoint-inclusive 14.375° φ spacing. The three input files and `manifest.csv` are beside it.
